sentences.text: No: for a Tier 3 urban co-operative bank, the applicable directions for loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 say it shall not levy any pre-payment charges on floating-rate business loans to MSEs with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this case is for ₹40 lakh sanctioned in March 2026.
The earlier RBI directions on floating-rate loan pre-payment charges were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
The bank’s own loan agreement clauses stating a 2% or 3% pre-payment charge exist, but the applicable RBI/UCB direction for this case does not permit such a charge.
